description: Pagination helpers for a listing endpoint: page_count, slice_page, has_next_page.

defects.notes: page_count uses floor division, so a partial final page is never counted: page_count(10, 3) returns 3 instead of 4. Because has_next_page derives from page_count, the final partial page becomes unreachable even though slice_page would serve it correctly. Every existing test passes: they only assert exact multiples (9/3, 10/10, 0/10).

false_positive_controls.reason: Correct. Handles partial final pages and out-of-range pages properly; it is has_next_page's gate that hides them, not this slice.
